brand_identity.name: BESTIC FASHION
brand_identity.key_visuals: High-fashion photography, soft skin tones, silk textures, ample whitespace

primary.description: Soft Black for text and primary actions

accent.description: Muted Gold for Platinum Seller highlights

layout.grid_system: Use 'The Bento Grid' Mode A for categories. Use generous padding (p-8 to p-24).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-none px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: border border-primary text-primary bg-transparent hover:bg-primary hover:text-white rounded-none px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs transition-all duration-300
buttons.ghost: text-primary hover:text-primary/70 underline-offset-4 hover:underline uppercase tracking-widest text-xs

inputs.style: border-b border-primary/20 bg-transparent px-0 py-4 focus:border-primary focus:ring-0 rounded-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50 font-light

motion.principles: Slow, fluid, elegant. Avoid bouncy springs.

hero.alt: Woman in white lace lingerie, luxury studio lighting

logos.note: Use text badges or simple icons for 'Flipkart', 'Myntra', 'Amazon', 'Ajio' as specific logos were unavailable.

phase_1_setup: Install dependencies: `yarn add lucide-react framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge`
Update tailwind.config.js with new colors and font families.
Add Google Fonts import in index.css (Playfair Display, Mulish).
phase_2_components: Create reusable UI components in `src/components/ui` (Button, Card, Section).
Implement the 'Bento Grid' for the Categories section.
Build the Navbar with transparent-to-solid scroll effect.
phase_3_pages: Develop Homepage with Hero, Categories, Bestsellers, Trust, Footer.
Develop Product Page with Image Gallery, Size Selector, Add to Cart.
universal_guidelines: Ensure all images have `alt` tags for accessibility.
Do NOT use gradients for text or buttons, stick to solid luxury colors.
Use `backdrop-blur-md` for floating elements like the Navbar.
Avoid 'Inter' font. Use 'Mulish' for body and 'Playfair Display' for headings.
